parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Welcome to all of you. Can everybody see and hear me? Good. I'm Sarah Connor, an HR representative of Earn and Learn. I have been asked today to talk to you about our company. So for those of you who don't know very much about the company, let me start by giving you some basic information about it.

Earn and Learn started nearly 20 years ago. It is not a charity but a for-profit company that (11) enables promising entrepreneurs to make money while travelling. During the past 10 years, it has grown rapidly and has gained great influence in most countries of the world. (12) We have a partnership with the school and take a large number of recent graduates from the business school. So if you are a recent graduate, I'd say you can consider applying to our company.

Before your application, you might be curious about what sort of places you could go to. There are four main locations, but you also have the freedom to submit a different location. And if they can make the necessary arrangements, you can go. The first country Earn and Learn established locations in was (13) the US, where you may choose from multiple locations as long as you can commit to their more rigid schedule of August to December.

Also, you could do (14) the Australia internship. That one is really cool. You work at a wildlife shelter and learn about the business practices of non-profit organisations. You do have to be willing to commit eight months for that one though. Perhaps that's a long time to be so far away, but I would say it is really an amazing opportunity.

I don't know whether some of you are in decent physical shape. If so, (15) the South Africa internship is another exciting one. You learn a lot about sustainable farming, but you would be doing some of the manual labour involved in maintaining a farm. Indeed, it's hard work, but I think you would definitely be able to do it. It may be wise to wait until after their summer is over, so it's not so terribly hot.

In addition, there is a most recently established location in (16) India. This one gives you more of a study abroad feel, given that they arrange a host family for you to stay with. In the other locations, you live in an apartment with other interns, so this is definitely a unique experience.

Regardless of where you go, at the end of the programme, (17) you get a global travelling certificate as long as you can explain your experience. You can provide a written log of what you did. I recommend writing journal or blog entries about what you do every day, or a weekly summary of each day.

Of course, you don't have to write up a formal report or anything like that, and (18) you need to apply for it once you prepare to return.

Some students may want to know whether this is a paid internship. Actually, you have to pay for the flight there yourself, but you have the opportunity to create your own small business, which could earn you money if it's successful, so basically you pay for it all up front. But when you're there, you can find ways to make money. That is to say, you pay for two-thirds of the cost up front as a deposit and (19) then give the final instalment one month prior to your return.

Finally, I have to remind you that (20) you need a health check before you go to make sure you're not going to spread any communicable diseases. In addition, before you go, you don't have to attend any meetings or workshops. You'll meet everyone you'll be working with once you get there.

Okay, well, that's all I've time for today. Thanks for listening, and I'm happy to take any questions if you have them.

analyses.content: 录音明确提到这家公司帮助有前途的企业家在旅行的同时赚取“钱（make money）”。
It is not a charity but a for-profit company that enables promising entrepreneurs to make money while travelling.
你可能听到了 "entrepreneurs"（企业家）或者 "profit"（利润），但题目语法结构 "make..." 后面需要接名词 "money"。
We have a partnership with the school and take a large number of recent graduates from the business school.
虽然提到了 "graduates"（毕业生）和 "business school"，但在 "cooperation with"（与...合作）后面，核心名词是 partnership 的对象 "school"。
录音中说公司与“学校（school）”有合作关系，并从商学院招收大量毕业生。

groups.description:
Complete the sentences below.
Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.

groups.contentHtml:
13 USA
14 Australia
15 South Africa
16 India

analyses.content: The first country Earn and Learn established locations in was the US, where you may choose from multiple locations as long as you can commit to their more rigid schedule of August to December.
不要把“多个地点（multiple locations）”误认为是条件，真正的限制条件（stipulation）是那个死板的时间段。
针对美国（US），录音强调必须遵守从“8月到12月（August to December）”这个严格的时间表，对应选项 E 的“特定时间段”。
You do have to be willing to commit eight months for that one though. Perhaps that's a long time to be so far away...
你可能听到 "wildlife shelter"（野生动物庇护所）想找相关的选项，但这里强调的是时间长度的承诺。
针对澳大利亚（Australia），录音说你必须愿意投入“八个月（eight months）”的时间，这对应选项 C 的“最短时间要求”。
If so, the South Africa internship is another exciting one. You learn a lot about sustainable farming, but you would be doing some of the manual labour involved in maintaining a farm.
虽然录音提到了 "physical shape"（身体状况）和 "manual labour"（体力劳动），但这些都是为了进行农业活动。
针对南非（South Africa），录音提到你会学到很多关于“可持续耕作（sustainable farming）”的知识并在“农场（farm）”劳作，对应选项 F 的“农业”。
针对印度（India），录音说这像留学，因为他们安排了“寄宿家庭（host family）”供你居住，对应选项 A。
In addition, there is a most recently established location in India. This one gives you more of a study abroad feel, given that they arrange a host family for you to stay with.
不要因为听到 "study abroad feel" 就去想学习相关的选项，这里的核心特征是住宿方式。

questions.question: What should you do to get the Global Travel Certificate?

analyses.content: I recommend writing journal or blog entries about what you do every day, or a weekly summary of each day. Of course, you don't have to write up a formal report...
录音明确说 "don't have to write up a formal report"（不必写正式报告），直接排除选项 B。
录音建议每天写日记或博客（journal or blog entries... every day）来记录你的经历，对应选项 A 的“每天记录活动”。

questions.question: You can apply for the certificate

analyses.content: ...and you need to apply for it once you prepare to return.
这里的 "before you leave" 指的是离开实习国家回国之前，而不是指出国之前；且不是 B 选项那种漫无目的的“旅途中”，而是有特定节点的“准备归国时”。
录音说当你“准备回来（prepare to return）”的时候就需要申请证书了，即在你“离开（实习地）之前”。

options.option: before you get your plane ticket

analyses.content: That is to say, you pay for two-thirds of the cost up front as a deposit and then give the final instalment one month prior to your return.
注意区分定金是 "up front"（出发前），而尾款是回国前，不要选 A。
录音明确提到最后一笔款项要在你“回来前一个月（one month prior to your return）”支付。

analyses.content: Finally, I have to remind you that you need a health check before you go to make sure you're not going to spread any communicable diseases. In addition, before you go, you don't have to attend any meetings...
录音明确说出发前 "don't have to attend any meetings"（不必参加会议），排除选项 B。
录音最后提醒，在你出发前（before you go）需要做一个“健康检查（health check）”。
